purpose: Test whether an existing clone-robust metric weighting is a cheap drop-in answer to the paper's locked registry-refinement attack before revising any claim.

accepted_predecessor.title: Clone-Resistant Weights in Metric Spaces: Handling Redundancy Bias in Benchmark Aggregation
accepted_predecessor.role: Establishes clone-resistant representation weights and a local-voting construction in Euclidean metric spaces.

implemented_construction.title: Breaking the Illusion of Artificial Consensus: Clone-Robust Weighting for Arbitrary Metric Spaces
implemented_construction.algorithm: Exact piecewise integration at all pairwise-distance breakpoints, following Algorithm 1.

graph_rules.class_uniform: Each closed-neighborhood equivalence class receives equal total mass, shared uniformly within the class.
graph_rules.mcca: Each maximal clique receives equal total mass and shares it uniformly among its members (additive maximal-clique weighting).
graph_rules.mccp: Each maximal clique receives equal total mass and shares it in proportion to inverse clique participation.

adaptation_boundary.selector: The locked independent equation-faithful Select-LLM instantiation.
adaptation_boundary.insertion_point: Replace the entry-uniform initial posterior by the clone-robust representation distribution; use the same prior in posterior acquisition and posterior-argmax deployment.
adaptation_boundary.nonclaim: The source papers do not evaluate this active selector. This is a role-matched drop-in adaptation, not their official implementation and not a new weighting rule.
excluded: No target, alias, temperature, budget, seed, or task is retuned.
No ground-truth label is used to construct the metric or weights.
No result-selected radius or graph rule may be presented alone.
No claim about all possible clone-robust weights is permitted.

locked_inputs.temperature_source: Use each task's already frozen response-only proxy-selected temperature.
locked_inputs.budget_source: Use each task's already frozen primary budget.

metric.name: full-dataset normalized categorical-response Hamming pseudometric
metric.reason: It is label-free, is the same prediction geometry used by the locked matched-cover audit, and is a valid pseudometric when exact-response aliases are distinct registry entries.
metric.metric_scope: One task-native metric is tested; radius and graph-rule dependence are fully crossed. Results may not be generalized to an unspecified or learned metric.

attacks.ineligible_task: gsm8k lacks enough parent-wrong positions under the frozen quality-identical operator

required_outputs: Exact reproduction of the locked uniform-prior clean and attack comparisons.
Residual query-path change and cumulative/final regret for every rule-radius-attack cell.
Clean-registry cumulative/final regret cost for every rule-radius cell.
Clean target mass, attacked root-collapsed family mass, and root-level prior total variation.
Weight positivity, normalization, entropy, effective candidate count, minimum and maximum weight.
For every radius, the maximum clean accuracy span and radius exposure of natural candidates sharing an equivalence class or maximal clique.
All quality-invariance, distinct-response, seed, target, temperature, budget, and input-hash assertions.

predeclared_interpretation.attack_suppressed_cell: Absolute residual mean cumulative regret is at most 10 percent of the locked undefended absolute mean and residual path-change fraction is at most 0.10.
predeclared_interpretation.cheap_clean_cell: Absolute mean clean cumulative-regret change is at most 0.10, its paired 95 percent interval contains zero, and its final-regret interval contains zero.
predeclared_interpretation.dominant_soft_fix: One single graph-rule and alpha pair suppresses all five eligible attack cells and is cheap-clean on all three tasks.
predeclared_interpretation.partial_soft_fix: No dominant fix exists, but at least one fixed graph-rule and alpha suppresses at least three of five eligible attack cells and is cheap-clean on at least two tasks.
predeclared_interpretation.tradeoff_or_failure: Neither dominant nor partial conditions hold.
predeclared_interpretation.paper_consequence_if_dominant: Retain the sequential attack and identifiability result, but withdraw any empirical implication that prediction-only soft weighting faces a material clean-cost frontier.
predeclared_interpretation.paper_consequence_if_partial: Report the soft baseline prominently and narrow the defense claim to uncovered cells and its observed metric/radius dependence.
predeclared_interpretation.paper_consequence_if_tradeoff_or_failure: The existing defense-frontier claim is strengthened only for these three published rules under this supplied metric; no universal impossibility claim is allowed.

synthetic_tests: far-component locality after adding an exact twin
agreement of exact breakpoint integration with a dense numerical quadrature
uniform-prior runner parity with the locked original runner
